reviews.text:
9-year-old female Toy Poodle, 3.5kg
I came here after a grooming salon pointed out an impacted tooth.
As expected, her overall condition was poor, and surgery was necessary.
I had opportunities before, but I was too afraid of general anesthesia and avoided it.
However, I couldn't avoid it anymore... I braced myself for my beloved dog's sake.
Honestly, my anxiety was so strong that I wasn't satisfied with the pre-operative explanation.
However, perhaps it was better that they were so matter-of-fact about it.
On the day of the surgery, I killed time at a department store near the hospital so I could rush there immediately if anything happened.
During the surgery, I received a phone call regarding the procedure. I trembled at the sound of the electrocardiogram in the background, but my dog ​​came home healthy.
She's been diligently brushing her teeth every day with the gel and toothbrush I bought here.
I screenshotted a successful surgery review from this clinic as a good luck charm, so I decided to write one myself.
The doctor's attitude wasn't very good; I felt like he was making fun of me... maybe it's because I'm a woman alone.
During the surgery, when I called, they seemed to have mistaken me for going out to play because there were shoppers in the background, and after I went to pick up my dog, they gave me a nasty remark.
When I mentioned that toothbrushes should be replaced every month, they said, "Humans change theirs that often too, didn't you know that?" (laughs)
I know that! (laughs)
While they're not exactly friendly to pet owners, they seem to take good care of my dog, so I plan to continue taking him there.
I heard there's a dental clinic specializing in Todoroki, so if you feel uncomfortable here, you might want to consider that one as well. Just for your reference.

I took my 2-year-old dog to the vet for a skin problem. Since our regular vet is a car ride away, my child, who was at home, was worried and took him. It cost several tens of thousands of yen. It turned out to be just dermatitis.

Later, the same symptoms reappeared, but our regular vet was able to diagnose it immediately and it was cured with medication.

I think that if the cost is suddenly high, you should explain the situation and get the family's consent.

I went to the clinic because the head dentist specializes in teeth. While his confidence is commendable, I found him unapproachable, his explanations insufficient, and his tendency to omit subjects in his sentences—perhaps a habit? Furthermore, his somewhat condescending attitude left me feeling disgusted. When I mentioned that my dog's breath has been a concern lately, he retorted, "It still smells bad." That's disrespectful to someone's beloved dog.

Even if he has the skills, I felt he lacked basic manners. I spoke to other patients in the waiting room to ask for their opinions, but they said they were still unsure.

While compatibility is important, no matter how skilled or knowledgeable a dentist is, if the owner feels aversion, they (and their pet) will likely stay away. I doubt they'll ever see him again.

I had been experiencing recurring diarrhea and loose stools, so I consulted Dr. Sugimoto, a specialist in gastroenterology.

Before visiting the hospital, I had an online consultation, which was very thorough and easy to understand, making me feel at ease before going to the hospital. Thanks to the doctor's accurate examination and treatment plan, my bowel movements have improved. I am very grateful that he answered my detailed questions without showing any displeasure. I'm glad I went to see him.

Thank you very much.

Our beloved dog, Melmo-chan.

She's 14 years and 8 months old, weighing 2.5 kg.

She's a small Toy Poodle.

She had her teeth cleaned at ages 7 and 11, but...
She continued to suffer from periodontal disease, and since this summer, she hasn't been able to eat properly.

We consulted several veterinary clinics, but were turned away because she's an elderly dog.

Desperate, we visited Dr. Okada's clinic.

She was diagnosed with severe periodontal disease, and underwent major surgery to extract all of her teeth, including four canine teeth.

Despite the significant handicap of being an elderly dog,
the surgery was a resounding success!!

A week later, she can eat again and is running around with incredible energy.

To our family, Dr. Okada is
"Dr. X"!!

Thank you very much (^-^)
We are truly grateful. Masaaki Ariji

I was examined by the director! 

I have four dogs at home, and one of them had really bad breath (smelled like feces), so I came in for a consultation. He carefully explained the problem with his breath and teeth, and after examining him, the problem was completely resolved and his breath is now no different from the other three. 

Thank you very much. 

I would like to have the director examine him again next time.

Since I'm hearing impaired, the vet was able to type on the computer, which made communication smooth and reassuring.
I thought I'd found a great animal hospital, but there was one disappointing thing.
My cat's surgery was scheduled for 9:00, so I was running late and rushed to get there by taxi, just in time. I then had to wait about 30 minutes before finally being able to leave my cat there.
I felt a little disappointed, thinking that if I had to wait 30 minutes, I wouldn't have taken the taxi in the first place.
What a waste! (T^T)

I recently had an online consultation with Dr. Sugimoto, a gastroenterologist.

I consulted him about my dog's diarrhea, and although the scheduled 20-minute session ran considerably longer, he listened patiently and attentively without showing any displeasure. He was incredibly understanding and supportive of my anxieties, which brought me to tears.

He explained even complex medical topics clearly, avoiding difficult jargon, and answered every question, no matter how small, with great care.

When I later inquired about something I forgot to ask, he called me immediately and provided the same attentive and helpful service.

I truly feel fortunate to have found such a trustworthy doctor.

I look forward to continuing to rely on his services in the future.

My 12-year-old Toy Poodle's teeth were in poor condition, so I took her to a dental specialist on February 25th of this year. She was diagnosed with severe periodontal disease, and surgery was performed on March 6th. She was left with only 7 teeth, but the explanations before and after the surgery were very thorough, and I felt completely at ease entrusting her to their care. I am so grateful for their clear and easy-to-understand answers to all my questions. Alice is now 13 years old, and she enjoys walks, sniffing around happily and energetically. Thank you so much.

I came to see him about my concerns about tartar and bad breath in my senior dog.
He keeps up with the latest academic information, and his thorough counseling made me feel he is a trustworthy doctor, so I will be entrusting him with surgery and other matters from now on.

I adopted an 8-year-old Maltese. She had terrible bad breath, and when I looked at her teeth, I found many missing or loose teeth. I looked for a dental specialist rather than a regular vet. Since she's such a small dog, only 2.2kg, I was worried about the risks of general anesthesia, so I researched various options and finally found this veterinary hospital. The doctor's explanation was easy to understand, and they had extensive surgical experience, so I trusted them and had the surgery done. She had periodontal disease, so she's lost all her teeth now, but the strange coughing she used to have when drinking water has stopped. Thanks to the surgery, she's eating on her own again, and I'm so glad I had the surgery done. Thank you very much.

I had my 9-year-old Toy Poodle's teeth checked and cleaned.

Since there are few dental specialists in Japan, it was reassuring to have one nearby. Dr. Okada provided thorough explanations and excellent service, and I trusted him completely. With the birth of my first grandchild, I also learned about the relationship between newborns and dogs, and the importance of daily teeth brushing, which was very informative. All the staff were smiling and kind!

We had our puppy's dental surgery performed here. The explanation was reassuring, and the post-operative recovery went well. I'm glad we came here.

We plan to bring him back for regular checkups.

We've been going to this clinic since it first opened.

The doctors and nurses are so kind to our little ones, and we feel completely at ease bringing them here.

It was my first time there, but the instructor was kind and taught me thoroughly. The interior was also clean and comfortable.

I will definitely be coming back.
The teacher was very thorough in teaching me how to brush my dog's teeth. I'm grateful that I was reminded that teeth are important for dogs too. The teacher was very kind.

My 4-year-old Pegingese and 4-month-old Pug are both patients here. Last year, the Pegingese received treatment for periodontal disease, and his bad breath has disappeared. Brachycephalic breeds are prone to periodontal disease, so we still have him checked regularly. Dr. Okada is a humorous and trustworthy doctor. I personally love the receptionist too; she's always friendly and very kind to the dogs (lol). I highly recommend this hospital.
The examination was thorough and the explanations were easy to understand. I felt reassured by the detailed explanations after the surgery. I also appreciate the aftercare.

My child had their first dental cleaning under anesthesia at the age of 8.

The dentist gave a thorough explanation, and I now make sure to brush my teeth carefully every day.

I learned how important it is to properly care for the tartar in the periodontal pockets.

I hope to be able to brush my teeth in a relaxed and enjoyable way.

I came to the clinic to have my dog's teeth cleaned. The doctors and reception staff were all very kind and explained everything clearly, so I felt at ease during my visit. The teeth cleaning procedure went smoothly, and my dog, who used to hate having his teeth brushed, now lets me brush them properly.

I was worried about my dog's bad breath, so I took him to the doctor. He was elderly, so I was worried about general anesthesia, but it went well and he's now running around happily. I'm glad I took him to the hospital.
It has a clean interior and kind teachers!

I took my elderly cat to this vet. I'd been worried about her for a long time, and other veterinary clinics weren't willing to treat her, so I searched around and finally found this one.

They said treatment under general anesthesia was unlikely, but they could remove the tartar, and they did it on the spot. I could see that a very large piece had been removed, but they didn't show it to me and just threw it in the trash can under the counter.

I didn't think much of it and went home, but when I looked inside her mouth after getting home, I was shocked to find a molar had fallen out. I'm now certain they threw it under the counter to hide the fact that it had fallen out.

Even if the tooth fell out, I'm sure my cat's condition was poor, but I can't help but feel distrustful of their attempt to conceal it.

It's been a while since my visit, but I still feel unsettled, so I decided to write this review.
I received my 3-month-old doodle's second mixed vaccine here. The atmosphere was very calm and the doctor was very kind. I'm glad I received your care for a long time to come.

This is a truly reliable and good hospital.
I went to consult about gingivitis in my elderly Chihuahua. The doctor examined him very carefully and gently, and discovered other conditions. He also sincerely discussed treatment priorities, and as a result, we were able to carry out all treatments in the best order. I also had a tooth extracted under general anesthesia, but the risks and pros and cons were explained clearly many times, so I was satisfied and left it to them. Director Okada and the nurses were also very kind and I am very grateful. It's a shame that I don't live nearby.

The doctor's explanations are thorough, and the reception staff are kind. The doctor carefully writes down the medical condition on paper, and when I ask questions about things I don't understand, he patiently explains until I understand. I look forward to continuing to receive care here.

I came to request toothbrushing instruction.

They were very thorough in explaining brushing techniques and suggesting toothbrushes, and the advantages and disadvantages of tartar removal were also explained clearly.

I had been using their services with my first dog, and this was the first time I used their services with my second dog. 
Recently, veterinary clinics have become more specialized, so my family knows that this is the hospital to go to if there are any problems with the teeth, stomach, or skin. It's a popular clinic, but you can check availability online, so it's easy to go.

We have three Chihuahuas, and we're very grateful for your care.

My dog ​​is 11 years old, but since receiving dental treatment, he's now able to have his teeth brushed, which is a huge relief compared to before.

The dentist is very kind and friendly, and treats both the dogs and us in a fun way, making it a dental clinic we'd love to return to.

We feel completely at ease having our dogs treated there.

I highly recommend this clinic.
My three Chihuahuas are always taken care of here. The vet and staff are very kind and gentle.
Thank you for your feedback.
Thank you for your feedback.

A few years ago, after having a tooth extracted at another hospital, I was relieved that the periodontitis had subsided, but shortly after, my dog ​​started licking its paws excessively. I was concerned when the licked areas turned brown, …

I found this hospital while searching for dental gel.
It's a dental specialty clinic, so I'd like to see them if something happens, and by chance, someone on Instagram invited me to come in for a consultation, so I …
Thank you for your feedback.
